ke 0.5
  • Reference
    • GB3 Kinetic Ensemble Analysis
Tools for Kinetic Ensemble analysis of biomolecular structures using nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) observables. Reads multistate coordinate ensembles and 'PDB' trajectories, detects equivalent proton permutations, constructs transition-rate and spectral-density data structures, and back-calculates dipole-dipole interaction tensors, cross-relaxation rates, and heteronuclear relaxation rates such as longitudinal (R1), transverse (R2), and nuclear Overhauser effect (NOE) data. Also provides utilities for preparing, reading, and writing restraint tables and for evaluating restraint energies from coordinates or trajectories. Methods are described in Smith et al. (2020) <doi:10.1007/s10858-019-00288-8> and Alhossary and Smith (2026) <doi:10.1021/acs.jpcb.5c08554>.
